Categories: Aion Silicon, Semiconductor Services

Daniel is joined by Oliver Jones, CEO of Aion Silicon, a global semiconductor design and engineering company delivering custom silicon solutions for the AI age. He leads the company’s strategy and growth as it continuously helps technology companies bring advanced SoC designs to market from architecture through production, across datacenter, automotive, and edge computing markets. Ollie has built his career at the intersection of deep technology and commercial growth, with more than two decades of leadership experience across the semiconductor, automotive technology, and advanced engineering sectors.
Before becoming CEO of Aion Silicon, he served as Vice President of Worldwide Sales and Marketing. He has previously held senior commercial and business development roles at a Li-ion battery startup, FTSE 100 engineering group GKN Automotive, and in motorsport at Williams F1, working on next-generation technology and high-performance engineering programs. He holds a Master of Engineering from Imperial College London and is an advisor to Silicon Catalyst, the semiconductor industry’s leading incubator.
Ollie takes Daniel on a deep and detailed tour of Aion Silicon and its rebirth from Sondrel. He describes the complexities of re-launching the company with a new charter and focus while retaining all the excellent capabilities developed at Sondrel. In a unique view of the process, Ollie explains how he and the company management quickly identified what needed to be retained and grown from the prior organization and what needed to be changed.
Today, Aion Silicon combines deep technical expertise with a high-touch approach to deliver high-performance solutions that power the next generation of innovation. Unlike larger firms, the company collaborates closely from concept to production, ensuring optimal solutions with no compromises. Ollie provides insights into how Aion Silicon achieves these goals with a focus on the growing demands for AI chip-level acceleration.
